title: lepidaploa psilostachya
intro: Lepidaploa psilostachya, commonly known as "erva-preta", is a species of plant in the family Asteraceae. It is a medicinal plant traditionally used in Brazilian folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lepidaploa psilostachya include its potential anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating conditions such as fever, pain, and infections. The bioactive constituents of Lepidaploa psilostachya include sesquiterpene lactones, which have been reported to possess anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities.
